topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This topic provides the opening framing, introducing the lecture's core themes on cancer evolution and outlining the expected learning outcomes.

topics.label: Cell-Intrinsic Drivers of Cancer Evolution and Clonal Selection
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how cell-intrinsic molecular alterations confer competitive growth advantages and drive clonal expansion in pre-neoplastic tissues.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Stem Cell Hierarchies in Tumor Initiation
topics.groupedBecause: They investigate how tissue stem cell hierarchies, self-renewal capacity, and cellular differentiation states determine susceptibility to malignant transformation.

topics.label: Role of the Microenvironment in Tumor Promotion and Maintenance
topics.groupedBecause: They demonstrate that neoplastic outgrowth and tumor survival depend on supportive microenvironmental signals rather than mutational burden alone.

topics.label: Technologies for Investigating Tumor Evolution and Cellular Interactions
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses the experimental, sequencing, and spatial profiling methods used to investigate cancer evolution and cellular interactions in the laboratory.

topics.label: Synthesis of the Evolutionary Model of Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes the lecture's conceptual model, concluding that cancer progression is a multi-factorial evolutionary process shaped by coevolution between cells and their environment.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This topic provides the closing framing, concluding the lecture and looking ahead to the upcoming session on cancer therapy.
